<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="Defs_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="开始">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_1" name="渲染 Markdown">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_1" name="完成">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_1" targetRef="EndEvent_1" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="Process_1">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_1_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_1">
        <dc:Bounds x="120" y="100" width="36" height="36" />

@enduml

title: SVG（受限）交付链路
description: 适合自包含、精确布局的静态矢量图。
body:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 320" role="img" aria-labelledby="svg-delivery-title svg-delivery-desc">
  <title id="svg-delivery-title">Markdown 图表交付链路</title>
  <desc id="svg-delivery-desc">源码经过安全检查后进入预览，并导出为 HTML、PDF 或 DOCX。</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="svg-delivery-bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef5ff" />
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#f4efff" />
    </linearGradient>
    <marker id="svg-delivery-arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="8" refY="3" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L0,6 L9,3 z" fill="#3974c6" />
    </marker>
    <style>
      .delivery-title { font: 700 24px -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; fill: #172033; }
      .delivery-label { font: 600 15px -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; fill: #172033; text-anchor: middle; }
      .delivery-meta { font: 12px -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; fill: #536076; text-anchor: middle; }
      .delivery-line { fill: none; stroke: #3974c6; stroke-width: 3; }
      .delivery-chip { font: 600 12px -apple-system, "PingFang SC", sans-serif; fill: #25633b; text-anchor: middle; }
    </style>
  </defs>
  <rect x="10" y="10" width="740" height="300" rx="22" fill="url(#svg-delivery-bg)" />
  <text class="delivery-title" x="42" y="55">Markdown 图表交付链路</text>

  <rect x="42" y="105" width="145" height="82" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#78a2e8" stroke-width="2" />
  <text class="delivery-label" x="114" y="138">图表源码</text>
  <text class="delivery-meta" x="114" y="164">Markdown fence</text>

  <rect x="226" y="105" width="145" height="82" rx="14" fill="#fff7db" stroke="#d6a83e" stroke-width="2" />
  <text class="delivery-label" x="298" y="138">安全检查</text>
  <text class="delivery-meta" x="298" y="164">预算与白名单</text>

  <rect x="410" y="105" width="145" height="82" rx="14" fill="#eaf7ed" stroke="#66a878" stroke-width="2" />
  <text class="delivery-label" x="482" y="138">应用预览</text>
  <text class="delivery-meta" x="482" y="164">缩放 · 全屏</text>

  <rect x="594" y="105" width="124" height="82" rx="14" fill="#f1eafb" stroke="#9173bd" stroke-width="2" />
  <text class="delivery-label" x="656" y="138">文档导出</text>
  <text class="delivery-meta" x="656" y="164">复用渲染结果</text>

  <path class="delivery-line" d="M187 146 H218" marker-end="url(#svg-delivery-arrow)" />
  <path class="delivery-line" d="M371 146 H402" marker-end="url(#svg-delivery-arrow)" />
  <path class="delivery-line" d="M555 146 H586" marker-end="url(#svg-delivery-arrow)" />
